name: GUN GRAVE
source:
"GUN GRAVE" is a rare type of adult game in which three different genres are fused together.

Firstly, it is an AVG that tells a fiction story set in the wild west. The player must advance the story by making the right choice while deepening the relationships with heroines.

Secondly, it is also a 2D RPG where the player solves mysteries and incidents by moving around the map, talking with different people, buying equipment and doing all kinds of errands.

Last but not least, the battles in this game are unique gun fights that requires the player to type English letters and Japanese Kanas on the keyboard to shoot enemies.

NOTE: Although a Japanese keyboard is not required, you need to be very familiar with the Kana locations on a Japanese keyboard in order to win the typing game.

PS: Japanese Kana location reference: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Language_input_keys#/media/File:KB_Japanese.svg
translation:
《GUN GRAVE》是一种罕见的融合了三种不同类型的成人游戏。

首先，它是一款讲述荒野西部小说故事的AVG。玩家必须做出正确的选择来推进故事的发展，同时加深与女主角的关系。

其次，它也是一款2D RPG，玩家通过在地图上移动、与不同的人交谈、购买装备和做各种差事来解决谜团和事件。

最后但并非最不重要的一点是，这款游戏中的战斗是独特的枪战，需要玩家在键盘上输入英文字母和日文假名来射击敌人。

注意：虽然不需要日语键盘，但你需要非常熟悉日语键盘上的假名位置才能赢得打字游戏。

PS：日语假名位置参考：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Language_input_keys#/media/File:KB_Japan.svg
